candidate_change: Battery number back: v239 lost it when wifid came up in the first second.  wifid now starts only after configd has prepared en0 and a power source is on the registry (or 150 seconds into the boot), and a wifid that has not asked the Wi-Fi driver for anything 60 seconds after it started is stopped and refused for the rest of the boot, so nothing that asks Wi-Fi is left waiting.
No library goes into wifid or airportd any more, and no thread of configd is sampled: v239 loaded the probe into wifid, redirected its output and sampled both daemons while they were starting.

Settings -> About stays fixed: configd publishes the interface-namer marker as soon as its own server answers, then every ten seconds for as long as it lives (the naming plugin drops it on its updates).

Wi-Fi: the kernel tells when wifid starts, when it first asks the driver, and why the gate opened; the driver logs each request with the caller's name.  configd lists en0, gives it a network service and asks the Wi-Fi manager for power once wifid is up.

Carried unchanged: the panic record slot (v238), the Settings hang dump with symbols (v238), protection classes A and B open for every process and IOSurface selector 21 (v237), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  The device tree keeps the wlan node.  No boot argument changed.
